title: Revert reject request
description: Planned (basalt_meta version 19, owner decision RS-2). The body of POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/reject, which the revert page sends under the link's current secret, on loopback or inside a Vault link session. No passkey: rejecting can only stop a revert. The engine calls basalt_meta.reject_revert and revokes the link; the answer is 200 { "revertId", "status": "REJECTED", "rejectedAt" }. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Rescope, widen and reject.

note.description: Optional, for the agent: the page says the agent will read it. Stored in the REVERT_REJECTED ledger row and returned in the agent's wait.
